strings.zh: 嘿嘿,欢迎你来我们公司啊。{NEWLINE}为了表示对你救命之恩的感谢,{CLEAR}那些从货箱里掉出的零星货物{CLEAR}你想拿就拿吧。
strings.en: Heh heh, welcome to our company! To{NEWLINE}thank you for saving our lives...{SCROLL}...feel free to take any of the loose{NEWLINE}goods that fell out of the crates.

strings.zh: 谢谢你刚才修理了这帮火箭队,{NEWLINE}你的精灵应该也累了吧？{CLEAR}我来帮它们回复一下。
strings.en: Thanks for giving those Team Rocket{NEWLINE}goons what for just now. Your Pokémon{CLEAR}must be tired, too. Let me heal them.
